description.7.0: Associate a geometry set with the current set. Geometric sets may be added, removed, or cleared for use with the current building blocks set. Geometric sets may be used with the “snapon” and “drape” commands available for face, edge, and point objects (and in some cases block objects; see building-blocks block snapon or building-blocks face drape , for instance).
description.9.0: Associate a geometry set with the current set. Geometric sets may be added, removed, or cleared for use with the current building blocks set.

keywords.name: add
keywords.description: Add a geometric set with name s to be associated with current building blocks set.

keywords.name: clear
keywords.description: Clear the list of geometric sets associated with the current building blocks set.

keywords.name: remove
keywords.description: Remove the geometric set with name s from the list of geometric sets associated with the current building blocks set.
